The dominant strategy in this auction is to bid your value. This is because, for any bid from others, you are always better off bidding your true value. If someone bids higher, you lose, but you would have lost anyway if you bid lower. If someone bids lower, you win and capture the surplus equal to your value minus their bid. Since this is round 1 and there is no history, I will follow the dominant strategy.
